Macaw, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. Macaw's public site paints one light theme. Coral is --primary600. The page is cream #fffdf9. The drawings below use those tokens. The real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from macawhq.com on 2026-11-18, signed out. Inter is linked from Google Fonts on the live site and is not loaded here, so the samples use the system sans.

Colour

Roles come from the light set: page, surface, text, accent, border, and the authored status colours. Status ramps are in the stylesheet and were not painted on the captured pages.

Ramps

Webflow ramps from the marketing stylesheet: gray, primary (coral), error, warning and success. Each step is an authored custom property.

Typography

Inter for the page, the buttons and the fields. Display is 53.6px bold. Body is 16px regular.

Families

font.family.sansInter on the site, system here
Generate AI content that humans love to read

Density, space and shape

Buttons and fields share an 8px radius. Plan cards use 12px. The nav is 80px on desktop and 72px on a phone.

Radius

Elevation

One soft control shadow, 0 1px 2px in gray-900 at 5% opacity, plus a 4px coral focus halo. There is no dark theme and no menu drop shadow on the captured pages.

Motion

Not captured as tokens. Buttons change fill on hover. No duration was written into the token file.

Layout

A cream marketing page. Desktop is 1440 wide with an 80px frosted nav. The content column is about 1024px. Phone is 390 wide with a 72px nav and a 40px menu button. The product app was not captured.
